sourceNotes: 网络设置支持手动选择流量统计接口，并在网络详情中显示实际使用的接口
网络速率与累计流量默认按单个物理出口统计，避免物理网卡与 VPN、代理隧道重复计数
切换、断开网卡或计数器复位后重新建立速率基线，避免流量突跳

en: Choose a traffic interface in network settings and see the interface in use in network details. Selections are retained when an interface is temporarily unavailable.
Measure network speed and cumulative traffic on one physical uplink by default, avoiding duplicate counts from physical interfaces and VPN or proxy tunnels.

Rebuild rate baselines after interface switches, disconnects or counter resets to prevent spikes. Discard reset baselines from the previous all-interface totals while keeping existing historical records.
